name: naughty-orchestrators-xD
description: Budget-driven, capability-aware multi-tier agent orchestration, plus a folder -> knowledge-graph tool. Two plugins designed to click together.

plugins.name: orchestrate
plugins.description: Bootstrap and operate a budget-driven multi-tier agent orchestration system in any codebase: scan -> infer -> generate a tailored CLAUDE.md hierarchy, then run a dispatch loop with a Devil's-Advocate gate, pre/post-implementation validation gates, capability-aware routing to installed sub-agents + MCP, and optional graphify-powered structure-aware impact.

plugins.name: graphify
plugins.description: Turn any folder (code, docs, papers, images) into a navigable knowledge graph with community detection and an honest EXTRACTED/INFERRED audit trail; query / path / explain + MCP server.
